jobs.title: Technical Project Coordinator - Modular Secondary Steel Construction (m / f / d)
jobs.description:
**Sikla USA, Inc.**

Sikla USA, Inc. operates from our Suwanee (GA) office and is a subsidiary of the German\-Austrian Sikla Group, a manufacturer of modular steel and pipe support solutions for the industrial, manufacturing mission critical and commercial construction markets. Our team services the North American markets (USA and Canada) in providing design and engineering support to owners, GCs and trade contractors, along with a logistical service to our partners, distributors and direct customers.


**Job Description**

The Technical Project Coordinator/ Specialist acts as a key technical interface between Customer Service, Engineering, Project Management, Operations, and Warehouse Teams, with a strong focus on prefabrication (prefab) and cutting\-related projects. This role supports the full quote\-to\-order process, ensuring that customer requirements are translated into accurate technical solutions, including drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and fabrication\-ready documentation. The position plays a critical role in ensuring technical accuracy, improving operational efficiency, and enabling successful project execution. The ideal candidate combines technical drafting capabilities, commercial understanding, and operational coordination skills.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Serve as the technical liaison between Customer Service, Engineering, Project Management, and Operations for all prefab and cutting\-related customer orders.
* Interpret customer inquiries, RFQs, drawings, and specifications to develop accurate technical solutions.
* Support the quotation and costing process by creating and validating Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Create and modify shop drawings using AutoCAD when standard Sikla drawings are not available.
* Ensure all technical documentation (drawings, BOMs, cut lists, specifications) is complete and accurate before order release.
* Translate customer requirements into fabrication\-ready packages for warehouse and production teams.
* Coordinate closely with operations and warehouse teams to support efficient execution of prefabrication and cutting jobs.
* Identify and resolve technical discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies across departments.
* Maintain and update project data within ERP systems to ensure data integrity.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization, and quality assurance initiatives.
* Provide technical support and guidance to Customer Service and Sikla team members.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings, mechanical layouts, and construction\-related documentation.
* Hands\-on experience with AutoCAD (or similar CAD software) for drafting and shop drawings.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (BOM structuring, calculations, data validation); proficiency in Word and PowerPoint required.
* Experience working with ERP systems and structured workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate across departments.


**Education, Experience \& Soft Skills**
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Drafting/Design, Industrial Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
* Minimum 3– 5 years of relevant experience in:
	+ Technical Sales Support / Inside Sales Engineering
	+ Drafting (AutoCAD)
	+ Engineering or project coordination
* Experience in construction, MEP systems, steel structures, or prefabrication environments is a strong advantage.
* Experience in quotation, costing, or project\-based customer support is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (American English).
* High level of reliability, accountability, and ownership.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Strong team player with cross\-functional mindset.


**Job Type / Compensation / Benefits**
* Full time (40 hrs/week).
* Working hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., onsite.
* Location: Suwanee 30024, and Buford 30519 (starting Q1 2027\), Georgia.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* Competitive salary dependent on qualification and experience.
* Optional supplemental pay (performance\-based team bonus).
* Retirement Plan 401(k) with a partial company match payment.
* Health insurance plans, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Paid time off (PTO) in accordance with Sikla USA policy.

* Coordinate closely with operations and warehouse teams to support efficient execution of prefabrication and cutting jobs.
* Identify and resolve technical discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies across departments.
* Maintain and update project data within ERP systems to ensure data integrity.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization, and quality assurance initiatives.

* Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings, mechanical layouts, and construction\-related documentation.

jobs.title: Executive Administrative Assistant / Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Responsibilities**

**Role Overview**  
The Executive Administrative \& Operations Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative, financial, compliance, and operational support to restaurant ownership. This position serves as a key organizational resource, ensuring that information is accurate, costs are controlled, compliance requirements are maintained, infrastructure is functioning properly, and projects and administrative priorities are completed on time.

**Executive \& Administrative Support**

* Manage executive calendars, meetings, correspondence, follow\-ups, and administrative priorities.
* Prepare reports, presentations, documents, and other materials for ownership.
* Maintain organized records, contracts, agreements, and confidential information.
* Coordinate communication between ownership, restaurant management, employees, vendors, accountants, and outside partners.
* Proactively identify issues, deadlines, and opportunities requiring executive attention.

**Financial \& Cost Management**

* Monitor restaurant costs and assist ownership in maintaining strong cost controls.
* Track food, beverage, labor, operating, and other controllable expenses.
* Review invoices, receipts, purchasing information, and vendor charges for accuracy.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding pricing, billing discrepancies, credits, and payment issues.
* Work closely with the accounting team to ensure accurate and timely financial information.
* Assist with financial reporting, reconciliations, budgeting, and other ownership requests.
* Manage and maintain **MarginEdge** information and workflows, including invoice processing, purchasing data, and cost\-related reporting.

**MIS \& Data Management**

* Own and maintain the restaurant’s **MIS (Management Information Systems) data**,
* ensuring information is accurate, current, organized, and accessible.
* Compile and distribute regular operational, financial, labor, and performance reports.
* Monitor key data and metrics and bring significant variances or issues to ownership’s attention.
* Maintain reporting systems, spreadsheets, databases, and other management tools.
* Assist ownership in analyzing information and turning data into actionable insights.

**Payroll \& Human Resources Administration**

* Coordinate and manage the restaurant’s payroll process, ensuring accurate and timely submission of payroll information.
* Review payroll data for accuracy and resolve discrepancies with management and payroll providers.
* Maintain payroll\-related records and documentation.
* Coordinate employee administrative paperwork, onboarding documentation, and other HR\-related requirements.
* Serve as a liaison between restaurant management, employees, payroll providers, and accounting as needed.

**Compliance, Permits \& Licenses**

* Maintain responsibility for tracking and managing restaurant permits, licenses, certifications, renewals, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar with all applicable deadlines.
* Coordinate inspections, renewals, filings, and communications with government agencies and regulatory bodies.
* Ensure required documentation is current, organized, and readily accessible.
* Proactively identify upcoming compliance requirements and ensure they are addressed before deadlines.

**Restaurant Infrastructure \& Facilities**

* Manage the administrative side of restaurant infrastructure, facilities, equipment, and building\-related needs.
* Coordinate maintenance, repairs, service calls, inspections, and vendor relationships.
* Maintain records of equipment, warranties, service agreements, and preventative maintenance.
* Track facility\-related expenses and ensure issues are followed through to completion.
* Escalate significant infrastructure, maintenance, or operational issues to ownership promptly.

**Project Management**

* Manage special projects assigned by ownership from initiation through completion.
* Develop timelines, task lists, responsibilities, and follow\-up processes.
* Coordinate internal teams and outside vendors to keep projects on schedule.
* Track progress, identify obstacles, and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met.
* Assist with new initiatives, restaurant improvements, technology implementations, and other ownership priorities.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and exceptionally reliable.
* Strong administrative aptitude with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with data, reports, spreadsheets, and technology systems.
* Strong understanding of restaurant operations, costs, payroll, and administrative processes is preferred, but not imperative.
* Excellent follow\-through and project management skills.
* Able to manage confidential financial, employee, and business information with discretion.
* Comfortable working independently while communicating effectively with ownership and management.
* Resourceful problem\-solver who anticipates needs and takes ownership of responsibilities.
* Prior experience in restaurant operations, executive administration, accounting/finance administration, or hospitality management preferred.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Fit Foodz is a growing chicken company focused on providing quality food and exceptional service to our customers. We are looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented person to join our office team and help keep our day\-to\-day administrative operations running smoothly.

We are looking for an **organized, efficient, and dependable Office \& Administrative Coordinator** who enjoys working with information, systems, documents, and people. * Communicate professionally and patiently with customers, vendors, and team members
* Learn new software, portals, and processes quickly

* **Highly detail\-oriented** with strong attention to accuracy
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills
* Strong working knowledge of **Excel, Word, and PowerPoint**
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, documents, and online portals
* A quick learner who is comfortable figuring out new systems
* Patient, professional, and friendly communication style
* Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Reliable, responsible, and able to work independently
* Someone who naturally likes to **organize, structure, and improve systems**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

We're looking for someone who doesn't just complete a task, but notices when something could be **better organized, easier to find, or more efficient**.

If you are the type of person who enjoys getting a messy spreadsheet cleaned up, creating order out of a cluttered filing system, catching small details others miss, and learning new programs quickly, you could be a great fit for our team.

* Opportunity to learn and grow with the company
* Be an important part of keeping our operations organized and efficient

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction telling us why you would be a good fit for the Fit Foodz team.

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

 Flexible location – you’ll be traveling between all 8 bakeries regularly (Kennesaw, Smyrna, Woodstock, Canton, Gainesville, Dawsonville, Cartersville, Roswell)\| FT

Hey you.  

Yes, YOU – the one who always gets “wait, who runs your Instagram?!” and somehow turns everyday moments into content gold.

Setting up \+ breaking down event setups (tables, signage, tents, cake magic)

Keeping content organized, on\-brand, and consistent across all locations  

Staying on top of trends and turning them into Bundt\-worthy moments  

  

  

We’re Looking for Someone Who Is:  

Social media obsessed (and actually knows how to grow \+ engage an audience)  

Comfortable being behind the camera *and* in front of it  

Creative AF – you see content opportunities everywhere  

Sales\-minded – you understand content should drive business, not just likes  

Outgoing, energetic, and confident talking to guests \+ team members  

Driven – you take initiative and don’t wait to be told what to capture  

Down to work weekends \+ events (that’s when the magic happens!)  

Cool with traveling between all 9 bakeries regularly  

  

  

Has reliable transportation (cake waits for no one)  

Okay with being on your feet, moving, lifting event supplies, and getting a little sweaty for the sweet stuff  

 The Perks:  


* $15/hr Monday\-Friday

* Mileage Reimbursement: If you're assigned to a bakery that is more than 35 miles from your home, you'll be reimbursed for all miles beyond the initial 35 miles.
* Bonus potential for every event sales performance you work (aka $$$ for crushing it)
* Fun, fast\-paced environment with cake everywhere
* A team that *actually* likes each other
* Bragging rights that your job involves selling cake and happiness

  

  

  

If you’re ready to turn cake into content, content into sales, and vibes into viral moments – apply now. Flexible hours, great pay, and a team that is FUN \& loves each other. Let’s make life sweeter (and more aesthetic) together.  

  

  

Email our Marketing Director, Emily Holt – emily.holt@janmangroup.com with your resume \+ your social handles (we *definitely* want to see your work ) and tell us why you’re the ultimate Content Queen/King to fast\-track your interview!

jobs.description:
**Clinical Field Specialist\- MEDICAL DEVICE \- Bilingual in Spanish is mandatory!**

Coverage Locations can be from the following:

Full\-Time \- Compensation: $60,000\-$65,000( Commensurate with experience)

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a driven and detail\-oriented Account Coordinator to join our growing Sales team. In this patient\-facing, field\-based role, you will serve as the primary clinical liaison—partnering with internal teams, healthcare providers, and patients to support every stage of the care pathway: from patient identification and coverage verification through product fitting, education, and outcomes follow\-up.

Your impact will be defined by clinical expertise, service excellence, and operational follow\-through—ensuring patients access therapy and providers can integrate it seamlessly into daily clinical workflows.

**WHY JOIN US**

Join a mission\-driven MedTech organization advancing patient outcomes through clinical partnership, field\-based support, and operational excellence. This role offers direct, meaningful impact, every interaction you have improves a patient's access to therapy and a provider's ability to deliver it.

Mission\-aligned work with visible, measurable patient outcomes

Collaborative team environment with strong internal support infrastructure

Opportunity to grow your clinical career in a high\-impact, field\-based MedTech role

Competitive hourly compensation with experience\-based increases

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Patient \& Provider Support**

Deliver on\-site clinical support to physicians, nursing staff, and allied health teams through patient evaluation, product ordering, fitting, and follow\-up visits

Serve as the primary point of contact for patient education on product application, compliance, and outcomes—ensuring confidence and adherence from day one

Provide hands\-on support in wound care, lymphedema, vascular, rehabilitation, or compression therapy environments as required by territory needs

**Order Management \& Documentation** Collaborate with internal support teams to ensure accurate clinical documentation, insurance coverage requirements, and timely order minimizing delays to patient access

Maintain precise, up\-to\-date records of patient status, field activity, and case progress within CRM/documentation systems

**Clinical Workflow Integration**

Partner with healthcare teams to build efficient, repeatable protocols for product utilization—reducing friction and improving consistency across provider sites

Identify and communicate field\-level insights to internal teams to drive continuous improvement in patient experience and operational outcomes

Travel throughout assigned region to support patient needs, clinical fittings, and partner facility engagement

**QUALIFICATIONS**

2–3 years of clinical or patient\-facing healthcare experience (e.g., Medical Assistant, Physical Therapist Assistant, Certified Nursing Assistant, or comparable role)

Demonstrated ability to deliver hands\-on patient support in a clinical or field\-based setting with professionalism and compassion

Clear, effective communicator with both clinical professionals and patients across diverse demographics

Highly organized and self\-directed—able to manage multiple active patient cases across geographically dispersed locations without close supervision Comfortable with regional travel including overnight stays and drives of 5\+ hours; travel expectation approximately 50–75% of the time

**PREFERRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

Experience in DME, compression therapy, lymphedema management, wound care, or vascular/rehabilitation settings

Familiarity with patient education, clinical fittings, prior authorization, or care coordination workflows

Exposure to insurance verification or payer requirements common in DME/HME environments Bilingual proficiency in Spanish is a strong plus

***Apply now to join a team where your clinical expertise creates real\-world impact.***

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $62,000\.00 per year

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Spanish (Required)

jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



VML is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and award\-winning human\-first work for clients including AstraZeneca, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca\-Cola Company, and Wendy's. jobs.description:

The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is responsible for outside commercial sales, lead generation, client procurement, and commercial job management. This primary role is outside sales of Floor \& Decor’s Commercial products to medium and large institutional buyers. In addition to working on leads sourced at the store level you will also act as a liaison with the Inside Commercial Sales team and the end\-user customer. In addition, this person will work with the Commercial Support Center to source, bid, and administer large commercial jobs.


Specific responsibilities include daily sales calls on existing customers. Will be required to present products to such entities as builders, developers, designers, contractors and all other decision makers in the sales and installation process. Additionally, must continually prospect for viable new accounts while developing a key awareness of what is happening within the (local) market.

**You'll be Successful With:**

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent \- Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 3\+ years previous commercial industry sales experience required (preferably within the flooring or building materials industry)

* Candidate must have familiarity with the LOCAL market
* Must be competent to work with and manage customer base thru CRM (Customer Relationship Management) tool such as Salesforce.com

* Experience working in a retail environment a plus
* Strong analytical skills and problem\-solving
* Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite

* Follow up on a variety of leads from sources such as Dodge, store leads, networking groups, etc.

* Submit proposals and responses to RFQs and RFPs issued by prospective customers after obtaining pricing and specifications approval from management, as appropriate
* Follow\-up with the Inside Commercial Sales team on key dates to complete sales and satisfy the customer’s requirements
* Work with the purchasing and inventory teams via the Commercial Support Center to confirm product availability or if a special purchase order (PO) is needed
* Stay current on merchandise training, new products and product lines
* Monitor prospects’ contract calendars and prepare reports on status of leads and other reports as required
* Participate in trade associations and trade shows, and assists in other promotional efforts
* Perform additional functions, duties and specific tasks of a similar nature and scope as necessary in order to achieve assigned business objectives

**Working Conditions (travel and environment)**

* Daily car travel with limited air travel based upon customer and/or corporate events
* The noise level in the work environment is typically quiet to moderate

**Benefits \& Rewards**


Bonus opportunities \& career advancement opportunities at every level


Programs that help you reach your financial goals: 401k with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Referral Bonus Program


Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and other Insurance Plans (subject to eligibility criteria)


Work\-life balance, including:


* Paid vacation and sick time for eligible associates
* Paid holidays plus a personal holiday
* Paid Volunteer Time Off that starts on Day 1

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Bring more to life.**

  

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1\.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

As a **Key Account Manager (KAM)**, you will lead strategic customer relationships within a defined portfolio, driving long\-term growth and delivering value for both the customer and Beckman Coulter Diagnostics. You will focus on retaining and expanding existing accounts while identifying and securing new opportunities within your territory. Partnering cross\-functionally with Sales Specialists, Health Systems Executives, Service, Finance, Marketing, and Client Services, you will ensure seamless execution and sustained customer success. This role requires strong business insight, financial acumen, and the ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, serving as a trusted advisor to shape account strategy and drive customer outcomes.


This position reports to the Regional Sales Manager, candidates must reside in territory, covering the Northern Atlanta, Georgia area.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Build and manage executive\-level relationships across assigned IDNs and Health Systems, acting as a trusted advisor to drive growth, retain base business, and influence key decisions.
* Analyze account performance and align Beckman Coulter Diagnostics solutions to customer financial and operational priorities in partnership with the Health Systems Executive.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to develop and execute multi\-year strategic account plans, aligning near\-term actions to long\-term growth objectives.
* Partner with Service to ensure successful implementation and ongoing support, maintaining a high\-quality customer experience and resolving issues as needed.
* Leverage Danaher Business Systems (DBS) tools to align resources, maintain pipeline and funnel accuracy, and deliver regular business reviews to customer leadership.
 **The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with 2\+ years’ experience or master’s degree with 0\-2 years’ experience
 **Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements:**

* Travel 50%\-75% of the time; In Person Customer Facing Meetings 75% of the time.
* Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
 **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* 3\+ years of Diagnostics Sales Experience
* Proven ability to understand customer business and financial goals and to position solutions that align with hospital operations, financial drivers, and healthcare economics
* Experience working collaboratively with local sales teams to support account execution and navigate long\-term capital equipment sales cycles
* Background in leading or participating in account planning sessions and contributing to executive\-level business reviews with both customers and internal stakeholders.
  

Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.


At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics can provide.

  

The salary range for this role is $100,000\-$130,000\. This role is also eligible for Sales Incentive Compensation (SIC). The total target compensation at plan (base \+ SIC) is $170,000 – $200,000 annually. Actual SIC earnings may exceed or fall below the target based on individual sales performance. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

  

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

jobs.description:
**About Loenbro**



Loenbro is a trusted, long\-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical \& Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long\-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.


**At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose.** Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.


**Job Summary**

  

  

The **Manager, Key Account** is responsible for managing strategic client relationships and overseeing project opportunities from initial identification through award or closeout. Operating under the seller/doer model, this role serves as the primary point of contact for clients within their assigned region and industry sectors. * Represent Loenbro at regional trade shows, association events, and client meetings to strengthen industry presence.

* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions and build trust.
* Highly organized, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned region to meet with clients and internal teams.

  


**Preferred:**


* Experience using Salesforce CRM and familiarity with Industrial Info Resources (IIR) preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  


**Physical Demands and Work Environment**



The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  


**Work Environment:**

* Potential visits to outdoor industrial sites with exposure to weather extremes.
* Potential exposure to noise, dust, chemicals, or other environmental factors.

*This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH\&S) policies.*

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Our mission statement begins with you:**

***Enthusiastic Employees...Flawless Performance...Delighted Customers!***

**6\+ Weeks of Paid Days Off in First Full Year** 

Yes, you read that correctly. We just believe in a work\-life balance. With 15 days of paid time off (PTO) and 16 paid holidays, you will have a total of 31 days off (6\+ weeks) in your first full year with us.

**But wait, there's more...** 

We add an extra 5 days of PTO in your second year for a total of 36 days off (7\+ weeks). Almost two months of paid days off.

**A little about Craft\-Bilt:**

We believe life is better outside. Fresh air and natural light aren't just enjoyable, they're essential for our mental and physical well\-being. Who really wants to be stuck inside under fluorescent lights, breathing recycled air, when we could be outside making real connections with friends and neighbors?

We are a mid\-sized, family\-owned manufacturing company that brings America outside. At Craft\-Bilt Manufacturing Company, we design and build high\-quality, affordable home improvements that help homeowners make the most of their outdoor spaces.

Our products include retractable awnings, sunrooms, decking, and railings.

**Important Requirement:** This is a **road warrior** position. You must be comfortable traveling extensively and staying overnight **Monday through Thursday each week** to visit client sites and support customer needs in the field.

**Salary:** $75,000 annually plus commission. You will receive 2\.5% commission on all sales growth above your annual baseline.

**What You'll Do:**

In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all customer account management matters, building and maintaining strong, long\-lasting client relationships. You will develop trusted partnerships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors while ensuring the timely and successful delivery of our solutions in alignment with customer needs and objectives. This position also requires clearly communicating the progress of monthly and quarterly initiatives to both internal and external stakeholders. You will be responsible for forecasting and tracking key account metrics, such as sales performance and client retention, identifying opportunities to grow accounts through upselling and cross\-selling, and resolving client issues and concerns in a timely and effective manner

**What We're Looking For:**

We are seeking a candidate with proven experience as an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, or in a similar role. The ideal individual will have a demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence effectively at all levels of an organization. They should be confident in managing multiple priorities and adapting quickly in a fast\-paced environment. Strong listening, negotiation, and presentation skills are essential, along with excellent verbal and written communication abilities. This role requires someone who is comfortable taking initiative, handling a variety of responsibilities, and wearing multiple hats. A willingness and ability to travel overnight Monday through Thursday on a weekly basis is also required.

**Perks \& Benefits:**

* **Fully Paid Medical \& Dental Insurance** \- Coverage for you and your eligible dependents
* **Financial Security** \- Company\-paid short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan
* **Growth \& Stability** \- A full\-time, year\-round position in a company that values its employees and their expertise

At Craft\-Bilt, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We provide a fantastic workplace, excellent benefits, and a role where you can truly make an impact.

**Ready to join a team where your customer relationship skills and road warrior mindset shine? Apply today!**

Pay: $74,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

As a brand ambassador for Club Pilates and Aligned Fitness Holdings, this individual is responsible for building relationships, driving membership sales, supporting member retention, and fostering a welcoming studio community.
This role combines sales, customer service, and operational support responsibilities, requiring a highly motivated individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is passionate about health, wellness, and helping others achieve their fitness goals.

* Generate new membership sales through proactive outreach, lead follow\-up, and relationship\-building efforts.
* Conduct consultations with prospective members to understand their fitness goals and recommend appropriate membership options.

* Meet or exceed individual and studio sales goals and key performance metrics.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all sales activities, communications, and member interactions within ClubReady.

**Member Experience \& Customer Service**
* Deliver exceptional service by warmly greeting members and guests and creating a positive, professional studio atmosphere.
* Build strong relationships with members to enhance engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**


**About Us:**  

Atlanta\-based Incident IQ is the leading workflow management platform built exclusively for K\-12 districts. Trusted by over 2,000 districts, Incident IQ powers mission\-critical services for more than 12 million students and educators nationwide. By connecting technology and operational workflows, Incident IQ enables schools to streamline processes, reduce administrative burdens, and focus on what matters most: supporting students.


**Purpose:**  

Incident IQ is committed to creating a future where every K\-12 district operates with seamless efficiency. When operations are unified on a single platform, districts gain the clarity and control needed to build a stronger foundation for student success. We're focused on delivering the tools, support, and partnerships that help make that vision a reality.


**Mission:**  

Incident IQ is on a mission to eliminate the friction of disconnected systems and clunky workflows that slow schools down. We're reimagining the critical work that happens behind the scenes, bringing visibility, efficiency, and impact to the processes that keep classrooms running. By streamlining the complex, automating the routine, and surfacing the insights that matter most, we can create the conditions for educators to teach, students to thrive, and districts to shape the future of education.

**Implementation Specialist Overview:**

  



The Implementation Specialist is the subject matter expert who works directly with our K\-12 School District clients to understand detailed client needs in order to deliver a tailored Incident IQ Platform solution while managing expectations, timelines, and resources. The Implementation Specialist coordinates communications and activities between internal teams and clients and is critical to the overall success of every project. No two projects are the same, allowing for creative solutions that satisfy each client.

  



This position is responsible for executing and overseeing the project management activities related to the implementation of cloud software and services for new clients and providing ongoing support.

  



We look for excellent communication, time management, and organization skills with the ability to juggle multiple personalities and projects. You must have a strong technical aptitude and a good understanding of hardware, software, mobile and networking technologies and a passion for customer satisfaction.

  


**Implementation Specialist Responsibilities:**


* Lead and manage Client Onboarding projects for Incident IQ cloud software products and related services from after sale to go\-live
* Serve as a primary point of contact between clients and the support team during all phases of the implementation project to achieve defined success, including the recognition and handling of escalated issues.
* Communicate directly with the client to manage expectations, scope changes, and monitor client contributions to the project
* Maintain documentation and record project status updates using internal tools to track progress against milestones and identify any items holding up further implementation.
* Provide assistance with implementation tasks including installation, configuration to meet client preferences, training, and support for the initial implementation period
* Manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects
* Recognize opportunities for process improvement and provide input for proper implementation
* May participate in special projects or other duties as assigned

  


**Implementation Specialist Requirements:**


* Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in a related discipline.
* 1 to 3 years of related professional customer experience; prefer SaaS Customer Success
* Basic planning/organizational skills and techniques
* Basic analysis and problem solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including both inbound and outbound phone calls and general proficiency in business writing
* Ability to communicate and develop relationships with all levels of the organization
* Resourceful, flexible, adaptable and ability to work well with limited direction and oversight
* Professional and confident presence with a consultative, customer\-focused attitude
* Strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple independent projects simultaneously
* Proven professional experience with both client/server and cloud based (SaaS) applications and services
* Possess strong technical aptitude and experience working with enterprise\-class business software solutions
* Excellent computer skills including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, SaaS applications, and webinar or conference/meeting applications.
* Proven professional experience with project management, including scheduling of tasks and management of small to mid\-sized projects

 **What makes Incident IQ different:**


* We facilitate whole\-person growth where employees can develop personally as well as professionally.
* We offer an energetic and collaborative environment; everyone's opinion matters!
* We produce software that empowers K\-12 schools to run efficiently, allowing for a better classroom experience for students to THRIVE!
* We provide excellent work/life balance. Two amazing offices \- a Downtown Atlanta office location and one at Halcyon in Alpharetta!

  



Incident IQ offers a competitive salary based on experience with a benefits package for full\-time employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k match, and paid\-time off (PTO).

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant**



As the **Executive Assistant**, you will play a key role in supporting the company’s legal, regulatory, and executive functions. You’ll manage corporate entities, licenses, permits, compliance deadlines, and acquisition\-related activities while providing high\-level administrative support to the President and senior leadership. This role is ideal for a highly organized, discreet, technology\-forward professional who can manage competing priorities, build strong relationships across the organization, and use technology and AI to streamline processes and support a growing company.


**What You’ll Be Doing**


* You will manage the lifecycle of corporate legal entities, including formations, registrations, annual renewals, filings, maintenance, and dissolutions across multiple states and jurisdictions.
* You will oversee liquor licenses, business licenses, food service licenses, hotel licenses, permits, and other regulatory requirements across the company’s properties and locations.
* You will maintain compliance calendars, licensing records, corporate documentation, and audit\-ready files while proactively tracking deadlines and renewals.
* You will coordinate with outside legal counsel, registered agents, government agencies, Accounting, Operations, Human Resources, Business Development, and property leadership to ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.
* You will support new acquisitions, management takeovers, property openings, and transitions by coordinating entity formations, EINs, state registrations, licenses, permits, and required documentation.
* You will assist with due diligence, M\&A activities, financing, audits, and other legal and corporate projects as needed.
* You will maintain corporate governance records, including organizational documents, resolutions, minute books, cap tables, and organizational charts.
* You will manage the transfer, renewal, and closure of licenses associated with property openings, ownership changes, property sales, and entity dissolutions.
* You will support brand and investor administration, including employee ID setups, annual investor tax document distribution, and maintaining accurate property and business unit records.
* You will serve as a company notary public for corporate and legal documents.
* You will use technology, automation, and AI tools to improve compliance tracking, document management, renewal processes, and recurring administrative workflows.
* You will manage complex calendars, travel arrangements, meetings, correspondence, expenses, and other administrative responsibilities for the President and senior leadership team.
* You will coordinate executive meetings, offsites, and board meetings, including logistics, materials, follow\-up items, and communication.
* You will serve as a trusted liaison between the President’s office, internal departments, external partners, board members, and other key stakeholders.
* You will handle confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information with a high level of discretion and professionalism.
* You will continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, automate recurring work, and create scalable systems as the organization continues to grow.


**Education \& Experience**


* Paralegal certificate, degree, or equivalent professional experience in corporate or legal compliance.
* Three (3\) or more years of experience managing corporate compliance, licensing, regulatory filings, or related legal administration.
* Hospitality, restaurant, alcohol beverage, multi\-state real estate, or franchise industry experience, highly preferred.
* Experience managing multi\-state business licenses and/or liquor licenses.
* Experience supporting C\-suite executives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with state Secretary of State filing systems and Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and document management platforms such as SharePoint.
* Experience navigating state, county, and municipal filing portals.
* Hands\-on experience using AI or automation tools to streamline legal, compliance, administrative, or document\-management processes.
* Active notary public commission, or willingness to obtain one shortly after hire.


**Essentials**



To be a successful candidate, you will need the following:


* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of recurring deadlines across multiple states, entities, properties, and executives.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, outside counsel, government agencies, and property teams.
* High degree of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills with the ability to exercise sound judgment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships and work effectively across multiple departments while balancing competing priorities.
* Technology\-forward mindset with the ability and willingness to use AI, automation, and digital tools to improve efficiency.
* Ability to embrace HVMG’s Culture of Excellence by demonstrating professionalism, a positive attitude, and a commitment to exceptional service.
* Amazing opportunities for career advancement across HVMG
* Flexible PTO
* Up to 40% earned wages paid BEFORE payday with PayActive
* Full Healthcare Benefits (including medical, dental, and vision coverage)
* 401k Retirement Plan with a guaranteed 4% match and no vesting
* Hotel and Food and Beverage Discounts and Perks

### **Who We Are**



At ERC Pathlight, we're on a mission to change lives—and we're looking for people who feel called to do the same.



As one of the nation's leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma\-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence\-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.



Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world\-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.


### **Why Join Us**



When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You'll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission\-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.



Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. **You** matter.



If you're energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.


**Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.**


**What you'll be doing:**


* Schedule: PRN (as needed)

* Ensures adherence to allergy\-safety system

* Distributes mail and packages daily

Program Coordinator I (PC I)

Tidal Link Media is looking for a Project Coordinator to join our Culver City team and help keep the flow of goods, materials, and vendor relationships running smoothly from end to end. This role sits at the center of our supply chain operations, working closely with procurement, logistics, warehouse, and finance teams to make sure orders move on schedule and inventory stays accurate.

You will be the person who catches a delayed shipment before it becomes a production problem, who spots a discrepancy in inventory counts before it throws off a report, and who keeps vendor relationships steady even when timelines get tight. It is a role with real variety day to day, and one where your organization and follow\-through directly shape how smoothly the business runs.

As the team grows, this role has room to expand into broader ownership of vendor management, process design, and eventually a lead or senior coordinator track for the right person.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and track incoming and outgoing shipments to ensure timely, accurate delivery
* Maintain accurate inventory records and lead regular cycle counts and audits
* Communicate directly with vendors and carriers to confirm order status, resolve discrepancies, and manage delays
* Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations
* Monitor supply levels and proactively flag potential shortages or overstock situations
* Partner with warehouse and logistics teams to streamline receiving and fulfillment processes
* Identify and help implement process improvements that increase efficiency and reduce cost
* Maintain organized, accessible documentation for shipments, contracts, and vendor communications
* Support cross\-functional projects tied to supply chain systems, vendor onboarding, or reporting improvements

What We Are Looking For

* 1 to 3 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, procurement, or a related coordination role
* Familiarity with inventory management systems and solid working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and shifting deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for working with vendors, carriers, and internal teams
* A proactive, detail\-oriented mindset with genuine comfort solving problems as they come up
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Logistics, or a related field preferred, though equivalent experience will be considered

Growth and Opportunities

* Direct exposure to how a growing media company manages procurement, logistics, and vendor strategy
* A clear path toward a senior coordinator or supply chain analyst role as the team scales
* Opportunities to take ownership of process improvement initiatives and systems projects
* Mentorship and regular feedback from experienced operations leadership
* Cross\-functional collaboration that builds visibility across procurement, finance, and warehouse operations

Why Join Tidal Link Media

* Competitive salary of $65,000 to $78,000, based on experience
* Hybrid work model that combines in\-office collaboration with flexibility
* A collaborative, low\-ego team environment where your work has a direct, visible impact
* Steady operational culture that values reliable execution as much as new ideas
* A company at a stage where you can help shape how supply chain processes are built, not just follow existing ones

Location: Culver City, CA

How to Apply: Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief note on their relevant experience.

Tidal Link Media is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $50,000\.00 per year

Lightship is a clinical trial site organization delivering on\-site, hybrid, and virtual trials through a single, trusted partner. Our expanded reach model places each visit in the most practical setting, increasing access, strengthening enrollment and engagement, and improving representation across diverse communities.  

  

Our investigators and study teams follow participants across all visit types, supported by a unified SOP framework and shared technology backbone. This continuity preserves oversight, streamlines study conduct, and gives sponsors auditable visibility across the entire participant journey.  

  

With a growing footprint of eight physical sites and mobile research units (MRUs) that extend site capabilities into the community, Lightship increases access for participants who might otherwise be out of reach. Our 96 percent retention rate, 30\-plus sponsor audits, and multiple FDA engagements reflect a strong quality record that gives sponsors confidence in a reliable path to high\-performing trial execution.  

  

We’re building trial experiences that reflect real life: expanding reach, reducing burden, and bringing better therapies to market faster.

Lightship aims to bring life\-changing treatments to more patients in need by supporting community\-based clinics with clinical research resources.


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to join our research team. The CRC will be responsible for the day\-to\-day coordination and execution of assigned clinical trials in accordance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (ICH E6(R3\)), applicable FDA regulations, IRB/IEC requirements, Lightship Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and applicable site or institutional requirements.


This position requires initiative, professionalism, strong organizational skills, and the ability to independently manage day\-to\-day study operations within appropriately trained, qualified, and delegated responsibilities while supporting appropriate oversight by the Principal Investigator (PI).

* Recruit and pre\-screen potential participants; perform protocol\-specific screening activities; support the informed consent process; obtain informed consent when appropriately trained, delegated, and permitted; and coordinate participant enrollment in accordance with the protocol, IRB\-approved documents, and applicable requirements.
* Coordinate participant study visits, retention, and follow\-up activities. Perform protocol\-required study procedures within the CRC’s documented training, qualifications, and delegated responsibilities.

* Complete accurate and timely study data entry and review and facilitate timely resolution of data queries, discrepancies, missing information, and sponsor/monitor requests.
* Identify, document, and promptly escalate adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), protocol deviations, and other significant study issues to the Principal Investigator and appropriate study personnel. Support required safety and regulatory reporting within delegated responsibilities.
* Prepare for, coordinate, and support site qualification/pre\-study visits, site initiation visits, interim monitoring visits, close\-out visits, sponsor or quality audits, and regulatory inspections. Track and facilitate timely resolution of monitoring findings, audit observations, and action items.
* Perform delegated investigational product activities, as applicable, including receipt, storage, temperature monitoring, accountability, reconciliation, dispensing support, returns, and coordination with clinical pharmacies or other responsible personnel.
* Educate participants regarding study requirements, study medications or investigational product instructions as appropriate, visit schedules, study procedures, participant responsibilities, and whom to contact with study\-related questions or concerns.
* Protect participant privacy and confidentiality and handle clinical research records and information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements, study requirements, and Lightship policies.
* Manage study supplies, laboratory kits, specimen materials, shipping supplies, and other study\-specific materials, including inventory and expiration\-date tracking, as applicable.
* Track study recruitment, screening, enrollment, and retention activities and communicate study status, operational risks, barriers, and required escalations to the PI and appropriate study stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
We're looking for a Social Media Manager to own social strategy and performance for Bedrosians — growing our engagement and community. You'll set content direction, turn performance data into next steps, and manage a growing network of creators, influencers, and designers, including partnerships and collaborations.


Our in\-house creative team will assist with direction and production; you bring the platform expertise and performance rigor that shape what that creative needs to accomplish. You'll also shoot and edit native content yourself when needed. You'll partner closely with creative and internal teams, and coordinate with our paid social agency to keep organic and paid aligned.

**PLEASE NOTE: This role is an on\-site M\-F located in Tustin, CA. We do not offer remote or hybrid options. Please do not apply if you cannot be present on\-site M\-F.**

  

**Compensation:**
$100,000 – $125,000

 **Responsibilities:****Social Strategy \& Performance**

* Build and own the social strategy end\-to\-end — audience growth, engagement, conversion, and retention — with clear goals and KPIs at every stage.
* Turn platform, campaign, and site data into concrete, actionable recommendations for content, targeting, and creative direction — insights that change what gets made, not just a monthly readout.
* Design and run an ongoing testing program across hooks, formats, messaging, and posting cadence, and use results to continuously refine the plan.
* Report performance on a regular cadence, connecting social activity to business outcomes — traffic, leads, conversion, and retention.

**Content Planning \& Native Execution**

* Own the content calendar and day\-to\-day publishing cadence across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and emerging platforms.
* Partner with the creative team on campaign concepts, translating brand and business priorities into clear content briefs — they lead art direction and production; you make sure the output is platform\-native and on\-strategy.
* Shoot and edit lighter, fast\-turnaround native content (behind\-the\-scenes, trend\-driven, UGC\-style) as needed, working within the creative team's established visual direction rather than setting it independently.
* Write and adapt captions and copy to match intent — from brand storytelling to conversion\-focused copy.

**Creator, Influencer \& Designer Partnerships**

* Source, onboard, and manage a network of UGC creators, influencers, and designers who reflect Bedrosians' credibility with both trade pros and homeowners.
* Own influencer and designer collaborations end\-to\-end — outreach, negotiation, briefing, and execution.
* Write clear, performance\-oriented briefs and keep a steady pipeline of creator and partner content for testing.
* Track creator\- and partner\-level performance and double down on what drives results.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Work side by side with the Creative Director and creative team as the strategy and performance counterpart to their creative leadership.
* Partner with paid social, e\-commerce, and trade marketing to align organic and paid strategy and keep creative fresh.
* Coordinate with the paid social agency to identify organic content worth amplifying and flag where creative is starting to fatigue.

 **Qualifications:**
7–10 years of experience in social media strategy, management, or performance marketing, with a track record of owning results — not just output.

* Demonstrated ability to connect content to real business outcomes — not just engagement, but traffic, conversion, and repeat business.
* Strong analytical ability; comfortable pulling insights from platform analytics, GA4, or similar tools and turning them into content and strategy decisions.
* Experience partnering with a creative team or art director to execute campaigns, including writing briefs and giving platform\-informed feedback.
* Working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram/Meta, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, plus hands\-on experience with a social scheduling/management tool such as Sprout Social or Dash Social.
* Experience building and managing creator, influencer, and designer partnerships — outreach, negotiation, briefing, and rights management.
* Strong copywriting instincts, able to move between brand storytelling and conversion\-focused copy.
* Excellent organizational skills — able to manage a content calendar, creator relationships, and cross\-functional stakeholders at once without things slipping.

**Nice to Have**

* A background or genuine interest in interior design, home furnishings, or a related lifestyle/design category — an eye for interiors and materials is a plus, though not required.
* Basic native content shooting/editing skills (iPhone video, CapCut, or similar) for fast\-turnaround content.
* Experience in home, building products, or another considered\-purchase DTC category.

 **About Company**  

Since 1948, Bedrosians have been a trusted leader in tile and stone. With 40\+ showrooms across the country, a direct\-to\-consumer site, and strong relationships with designers, contractors, and retailers, we are investing in the future of omnichannel marketing to deliver seamless and inspiring customer experiences.

**ORGANIZATION DESCRIPTION**


Founded in 1965, the Chinese\-American Planning Council (CPC) is a social services organization advancing the social and economic well\-being of immigrant and low\-income New Yorkers through holistic services and community\-led impact. CPC is the nation’s largest Asian American social services organization and serves as a trusted community anchor to over 80,000 community members who are served by CPC annually through 50\+ high\-quality programs and services across 35 sites in New York City. (For more information, please visit: https://www.cpc\-nyc.org)


**DIVISION SUMMARY**


CPC Education and Career Services (ECS) provides dynamic programs and activities that bridge youth and adults with their highest educational, economic and leadership potential. ECS believes it is never too early or too late to start learning, which is why an asset\-based approach is used to maximize clients’ current strengths. Whether in schools, community centers, or internship sites, ECS creates equitable learning environments that promote leadership development, self\-advocacy, and community building. ECS programs equip clients with essential skills and experiences today so that they are empowered to take the next step tomorrow.

**PROGRAM SUMMARY**


The Learn and Earn Program provides work readiness skills training, college access support, leadership development and employment opportunities for youth and young adults. Youth are equipped with the experience and skills necessary to make a successful transition into adulthood and are empowered to become stronger advocates for themselves and their communities.

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Foster a positive and inclusive atmosphere where students feel comfortable and motivated to participate.
* Manage small caseload of students and provide on\-going guidance and support while they are enrolled in the Learn \& Earn Program.
* Develop and implement a diverse range of after\-school activities that cater to the interests and needs of high school students.
* Create and organize educational workshops, recreational activities, and skill\-building sessions for students.
* Document student progress, challenges, and any changes in their circumstances.
* Complete worksite visits and assessments while students are engaged in internships.
* Ensure that all enrolled participants successfully complete all program components and achieve expected outcomes.
* Enter data, visits, and student progress notes into the DYCD database.
* Collaborate with teachers, administrators, and community partners to enhance the overall educational experience.
* Support school with implementing a comprehensive participant outreach, recruitment, selection, enrollment and placement strategy.
* Fulfill other duties as assigned by the Program Director.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Youth Studies, Education, Psychology, Sociology, Social Work, etc.) and at least two (2\) years of relevant experience serving high school aged youth or supporting workforce development and/or college readiness programs
* Candidates with an Associate’s degree (or equivalent) will be considered if they have three (3\) years of relevant experience serving high school youth or supporting workforce development and/or college readiness programs

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Familiarity with DYCD’s Promote the Positive Framework, including Positive Youth Development, Social and Emotional Learning, and Youth Leadership principles.
* Culturally competent professional committed to providing services in a manner that is sensitive to participants’ cultural heritage and traditions, life experiences, sexual orientation and gender identity.
* Strong work ethic and demonstrated passion for working with diverse populations, especially immigrant and low\-income communities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, time management and decision\-making skills
* Knowledge of MS office applications and virtual platforms such as Zoom, Teams, and Webex.
* Willingness to travel to worksites via public transportation.
* Fluency in English and Chinese, Spanish, and/or Arabic.

new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**

For over 40 years, Authentic Lifestyle Products has been a leading apparel supplier to big\-box, off\-price, and wholesale club retailers. We have an extensive private label business as well as licenses for lifestyle brands including RVCA, Billabong, Life is Good, Wolverine, and Elle.

We’re a dynamic, hands\-on team that values creativity, accountability, and long\-term relationships. Our team is genuinely invested in the success of the company — it’s a happy, collegial place where people love what they do and tend to stay for the long term.

We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented logistics professional. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working across finance, operations, shipping, and supply chain functions in a fast\-paced apparel environment.

**Logistics Coordinator** 

The Logistics Coordinator is a full\-time role responsible for managing the flow of overseas freight into our warehouses, supporting Authentic Lifestyle Products' apparel divisions. This position is based in New York, NY, and plays a key role in ensuring inbound shipments from overseas factories and vendors move efficiently from origin to warehouse, arriving on time, in full, and in good condition.

Day\-to\-day responsibilities include tracking and coordinating international shipments (ocean and air freight), communicating with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and overseas vendors, and monitoring shipment status from booking through delivery. The role involves reviewing and maintaining shipping documentation (bills of lading, packing lists, customs paperwork), reconciling PO and shipment data, and flagging delays or discrepancies before they become problems. The Logistics Coordinator will work closely with internal teams including planning, purchasing, and warehouse operations to keep inventory arrival timing aligned with retail and shipping deadlines, and will help identify opportunities to improve freight workflows and reduce transit delays or costs.

**Qualifications**

* Experience coordinating international/overseas freight shipments (ocean and air), ideally in apparel, consumer goods, or retail
* Familiarity with import documentation including bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, and customs entries
* Working knowledge of freight forwarders, customs brokers, and the import process from overseas factory to U.S. warehouse
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; comfortable managing multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously
* Clear, professional communication skills for coordinating with vendors, forwarders, and internal teams across time zones
* Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel) and ERP/inventory systems; ability to learn new tools quickly
* Ability to problem solve and escalate issues proactively when shipments are delayed or documentation is incomplete
* Prior experience in logistics, supply chain, import compliance, or apparel sourcing preferred
* Finance or accounting background a plus

new_jobs.title: SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT MARKETING MANAGER
new_jobs.description:
Maitre de Diamant is a fourth\-generation fine jewelry brand bringing a modern, social\-first approach to the traditional jewelry industry. Rooted in decades of diamond and fine jewelry expertise, we offer luxury jewelry with a focus on exceptional quality, design, value, and a highly personalized customer experience.

As we continue to grow our retail and e\-commerce business, we’re looking for a creative, highly motivated **Social Media \& Content Marketing Manager** to help shape and grow the Maitre de Diamant brand across social platforms.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who lives and breathes social media, understands how to create content that both builds a brand and drives sales, and is excited to work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You’ll be involved in everything from developing TikTok and Instagram concepts and scripting content to managing influencer partnerships, engaging with our community, and helping execute day\-to\-day marketing initiatives.

We’re a fast growing company, so this isn’t a role where you’ll stay inside one narrow lane. The ideal candidate is resourceful, proactive, creative, and excited to wear a lot of hats while helping build something.

This is a **full\-time, in\-person position based in the Diamond District of New York City.**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Create, film, edit, and publish social content across Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms, including concepts, hooks, scripts, and captions.
* Maintain a cohesive, elevated brand aesthetic while staying current on social trends, platform updates, and cultural moments that can inform relevant content.
* Manage the day\-to\-day social content calendar, including planning, scheduling, posting, and coordination.
* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and product inquiries, delivering strong customer service and helping convert social engagement into sales opportunities.
* Track social performance across engagement, reach, views, follower growth, traffic, and sales, using insights to continuously improve content and strategy.
* Identify, contract, and manage influencers, overseeing partnerships from outreach through content delivery, posting, usage rights, and performance tracking.
* Support product launches, promotions, events, TikTok Lives, and other brand marketing initiatives.
* Partner with the broader team on additional marketing, e\-commerce, retail, and brand\-building initiatives as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* No specific number of years of experience required; we care more about initiative, creativity, and a willingness to learn quickly.
* A true self\-starter who can identify priorities, manage their own workload, and figure things out in a fast\-paced, small\-company environment.
* Strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok. Confident writing copy, captions, hooks, and scripts, and comfortable taking high\-quality photos and videos.
* Strong visual judgment and an eye for composition, styling, branding, and a polished, cohesive aesthetic.
* AI\-savvy and comfortable using AI tools for brainstorming, writing, research, and workflow efficiency; Claude experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms is a plus.
* Experience in social media, content creation, retail, fashion, jewelry, beauty, luxury, or another consumer\-facing brand is a plus, but not required.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We’re looking for someone creative, resourceful, and highly self\-motivated who is excited to help grow a brand from the inside. This person should have strong social instincts, a sharp visual eye, and the confidence to take an idea from concept to execution without needing constant direction.

Because we’re a small, fast\-growing team, flexibility matters. You should be comfortable switching between creative, customer\-facing, and operational tasks, learning as you go, and stepping in wherever you can make an impact.

Above all, we’re looking for someone curious, proactive, and excited to grow with Maitre de Diamant. We believe skills can be taught. If you don’t check every box but are confident in your ability to learn quickly, grow into the role, and figure things out along the way, we’d love to hear from you.

**COMPENSATION**

The compensation range for this position is **$45,000 – $60,000**, commensurate with the candidate’s overall experience and qualifications.

Please submit your **resume, cover letter, and any relevant portfolio or work samples** – personal social media accounts are welcome if they showcase your content, creative eye, or social media experience.

Pay: From $45,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Marketing Associate
new_jobs.description:
About Ajaia
Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable return on investment across four practices: AI Strategy and Advisory, Workforce Training and Enablement, Process Optimization, and Custom AI Development. Our work sits with executives and the people who do the actual work, and it is judged on whether something changed in production, not on whether a pilot looked good in a deck.


Position Overview
Ajaia is hiring a Marketing Associate to run the channels that put Ajaia and our product suite in front of the people who make AI adoption decisions. You will own the day\-to\-day of our social accounts, help launch and build Ajaia's podcast, write the copy that goes out under our name, and hold the calendar that makes sure something ships every week.


This is a creative seat. We want a strong writer with real taste, someone who uses AI to make excellent work faster, not to make more work that reads like AI made it. The material you work from is what the business is actually doing: engagements landing, products shipping, ideas worth saying in public. Turning that into content people stop for is the job.

**Compensation:** $70,000 to $100,000 base, plus a performance bonus of up to 100% of base salary.


We are looking for someone who already makes content, for a company, a brand, or themselves, and can point at what it is. You do not need a marketing degree. You need to have shipped things, and you need an ear for the difference between a LinkedIn post, an Instagram caption, and a 45\-second video script.


How we expect you to work
AI use is a core execution requirement at Ajaia, not optional tooling. You will use it daily to draft posts, storyboard and cut video, generate first\-pass graphics, and turn a raw recording into clips quickly. You are judged on what you keep, not on how much you generate, and work that reads or looks AI\-made does not go out under our name.


Platforms and tools change constantly, and staying current with both is part of the job.


What you will do* Run Ajaia's and the product suite's social accounts day to day: LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X.
* Launch and build Ajaia's podcast: find the format, help book the first guests, sit in on the recording, then cut it into clips, write the show notes, and get it distributed.
* Write email and site copy that sounds like a person wrote it.
* Hold the weekly content calendar and keep it shipping, not just populated.
* Support product launches with the content plan that runs alongside them.
* Pull the numbers every week, say what they actually mean, and bring one thing to change.
* Build AI\-assisted workflows for the repeatable parts of the job so the same output takes less time next month than it did this month.
* Keep the asset library organized and the brand voice consistent across every channel you touch.

  

**Requirements**  

* A strong writer who holds a distinct voice across formats.
* Comfortable creating and shipping content yourself: writing, video, or design.
* Skilled with a video editing tool and a design tool.
* AI fluent: you use AI daily to draft, cut, and iterate content, and you can tell good work from slop.
* Organized enough to hold a weekly content cadence.
* Willingness to work on\-site in New York.
* A bachelor's degree is preferred and is not a requirement.

**Nice to have**

* Experience launching a podcast, newsletter, or show from scratch.
* Writing experience for a B2B or enterprise audience.
* Familiarity with marketing analytics tools.
* Experience at an early\-stage company with a small marketing team.

  

**Benefits**  

Competitive benefits.
